messages.text:
Not yet. The shop’s records show your cordless hand mixer has not been received back. It must arrive before a refund can be requested, so I won’t create a proposal now (refund-policy/v2/return).

Multiple payment records require staff review only for an otherwise eligible refund; they do not override the return requirement or make this request a staff case now (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Your refund request deadline is **7 December 2026 at 10:00 UTC**. The mixer must arrive and the request be created by then (refund-policy/v2/window).
